name: 2016-17 Co-Location Reporting
description:
This dataset contains 2016-17 co-location reporting for 1,131 New York City public schools, covering 27 fields per school. Each row represents a school identified by its district-borough-number code (DBN), district, and school name, along with the building ID where it operates. Flags indicate whether a school is split-sited across multiple organizations and whether it is a transfer school.

Enrollment data breaks down total students and counts by grade band (pre-K through 5, 6-8, and 9-12). Demographic fields report the percentage of students who are Asian, Black, Hispanic, White, or of multiple race categories not otherwise represented, as well as the share of students with disabilities, English language learners, and students in poverty. Academic indicators include the number of students tested and the number and percentage scoring proficient (levels 3-4) on English language arts and math assessments. Graduation fields report the total graduation cohort, four-year August graduates
